title: 1995 AMC 8 Problem 25
statement: Buses from Dallas to Houston leave every hour on the hour. Buses from Houston to Dallas leave every hour on the half hour. The trip from one city to the other takes \(5\) hours. Assuming the buses travel on the same highway, how many Dallas-bound buses does a Houston-bound bus pass on the highway (not in the station)?

solutions.text:
Consider a bus leaving Dallas at \(6\!:\!00,\) arriving in Houston at \(11\!:\!00.\) It meets every Dallas-bound bus that is on the highway during that window.

Dallas-bound buses leave Houston on the half hour and take \(5\) hours. The ones sharing the road (meeting away from a station) are those that left Houston at \(1\!:\!30,\) \(2\!:\!30,\) \(\ldots,\) \(10\!:\!30,\) which is \(10\) buses.

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Track one Houston-bound bus over its \(5\)-hour trip and see which oncoming buses share the road with it
Count the Dallas-bound buses already on the highway when it starts, plus those that leave before it arrives
